usedFor: Chatlayer builds your chatbots, and Google Drive holds the file that “Copy a File” duplicates whenever a “New Bot” appears.

bestTemplate.name: “New Bot” in Chatlayer, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new bot can get its own copy of a brief or checklist, placed in the folder you choose.

watchOut: “New Bot” is polling, and “Copy a File” can give each copy a new name, so name them clearly.
